name: chandler
desc: A ship's chandler in his forties who keeps a shop of oil, rope and pitch cantilevered out over a gorge: tidy and dry-humoured, pale skin, receding chestnut hair combed flat, small wire-rimmed spectacles, an inked tally-list tucked behind one ear. He wears a mustard-gold waistcoat over a grey collarless shirt with sleeves gartered above the elbow, a long canvas shop-apron with brass grommets, and a brass oil-measure in one hand; a coil of new rope hangs at his shoulder. Unhurried shopkeeper's courtesy.
sheetHint: tidy, flat-combed chestnut hair, wire-rimmed spectacles, mustard-gold waistcoat, grey collarless shirt with sleeve garters, long canvas shop-apron, brass oil-measure in hand
